vcu_g_0159_20001350.name: util_soft_timer_tick
vcu_g_0159_20001350.description: Free-running 32-bit software tick counter. TMR5_GLOBAL_IRQHandler adds 1 on each TMR5 overflow (probably one tick per 1 ms). It is the time base of all software timers: soft_timer_poll and soft_timer_start compare it with SoftTimer.start and period. Only incremented in the code seen here, never reset after boot. In VCU_148 the same counter is at 0x20001354.

vcu_g_14b_20001fb0.description: One-shot flag of software timer slot 1 in VCU_14b (probably SoftTimer.oneshot, slot 1 = offset +8 from 0x20001fa8). 1 = the timer disarms after it fires. Written by soft_timer_start, read by soft_timer_poll.

vcu_g_0159_20002054.name: util_soft_timer_table
vcu_g_0159_20002054.description: Table of five software timer slots (SoftTimer, 16-byte stride) used by soft_timer_start and soft_timer_poll in VCU_0159. Slot i: period at +16i, start +16i+4, one-shot flag +16i+8, armed flag +16i+9, callback pointer +16i+12. Slot 0 starts at 0x20002054, slot 1 at 0x20002064.
